subject: learning/code-internal-coveragegate-27ae25c955dd
statement: Package coveragegate measures repository-wide Go statement coverage from the standard coverage profile and applies a deterministic minimum. Measure runs go test with -timeout=25m and -covermode=atomic and omits -count=1 so an unchanged tree can reuse Go's cached coverprofile instead of re-running every package.
intent: Keep coverage-gate honest on statement coverage while allowing the Go test cache to shrink the success-path pre-push.
rationale: Explicit -count=1 disabled the test cache. Go stores coverprofiles in the cache, so a second Measure on an unchanged fixture reprints the same totals. The 25m package timeout still covers the long hermetic suites.
fit_criterion: Measure's go test args include -timeout=25m and -covermode=atomic and do not include -count=1. A fixture Measure run twice reports the same Covered, Total, and file count. Deferred RemoveAll and Close errors are discarded with a reason.
